_about: bf2-web's exported play site (WebPort/tools/export-play-site.mjs) as the site serves it: the build in the private bucket bf2017-assets that /battlefront/engine/<build>/ maps to (cloudflare/play.js), and the roots its page asks for by absolute path. build null: no build published, and the engine plays nowhere. export: the game's export as the bucket already holds it (web/, the folder bf2-web's BF2_EXPORT_ROOT names), so DEPLOY.md's extract/ copy isn't needed. mb: what a first visit downloads (the build manifest's totals, 2026-10-28: 104 MB of engine, 2,093 MB of the cooked scene). docs/decisions/2026-10-28-hoth-on-bf2-web.md needs: what the build's programs ask of the visitor's GPU, written by scripts/bf2web-adopt.mjs (lib/bf2web/engineSupport sends to the engine only a GPU that has it). levels: the levels the build plays (its play-config.json's, written by the adopt step); the galaxy opens the engine on the worlds whose ground they are (src/lib/bf2web/levels.js).
